profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI | Staff Forward Deployed Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Experienced technology leader with over 15 years of hands-on engineering, architecture, and leadership expertise. I excel at bridging business goals with technical execution, mentoring engineering teams, and driving innovation to deliver scalable, high-impact solutions.

Key strengths:
• Technology Leadership: Proven track record of architecting and delivering complex cloud solutions, ensuring scalability, performance, and alignment with business objectives.
• Business Partnership: Collaborate with sales, delivery, and product teams to identify opportunities where technology can drive revenue and improve client outcomes.
• Emerging Technology & AI: Lead initiatives to integrate cutting-edge technologies like Google’s Vertex AI into client solutions, enabling data-driven decision-making and operational efficiencies.
• Team Building & Mentorship: Actively mentor engineers and foster a culture of continuous learning, leading to high-performing teams and successful project delivery.
• Entrepreneurial Mindset: Co-founded a start-up and led product development from concept to launch, providing deep experience in product strategy and business growth.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) within the Applied AI division at Google Cloud, I partner with high-value enterprise clients to co-build and deploy production-grade Generative AI and agentic workflows. In this high-impact role, I rotate across strategic client accounts for short-term, high-delivery engagements designed to rapidly translate cutting-edge AI capability into secure, scalable, and tangible business value.

positions.title: Senior Customer Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Customer Engineer at Google Cloud, I serve as a strategic technical advisor for key enterprise clients in the automotive industry. In this pivotal platform role, I partner with senior leadership, engineering and sales teams to bring deep technical expertise and strategic guidance to complex digital transformation initiatives.

Responsibilities:
• Cloud & Data Modernization: Lead initiatives to modernize the client's core infrastructure and applications, while also helping them unlock the value of their petabytes of data and driving the adoption of Al and machine learning.
• Solutions Architecture: Designing and evolving scalable, secure, and resilient Google Cloud architectures tailored to the unique needs of the automotive sector.
• Technical Partnership: Maintaining strong relationships with senior customer leaders and collaborating with a team of specialist Customer Engineers to ensure successful outcomes.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Lead the technical strategy and execution for client services, ensuring alignment with Detroit Labs' business goals. Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, cloud-first solutions that drive business impact.

Notable Contributions:
• Enterprise AI Platform Development: Architected and built Detroit Labs Doc AI, an enterprise search and document intelligence platform leveraging Google Vertex AI, Generative AI, and semantic search. This platform, developed before Notebook LM's GA release, powers advanced knowledge retrieval for enterprise clients, including production deployments for multiple brands.
• Driving AI Integration: Led efforts to grow AI capabilities by integrating Google Vertex AI into client solutions, enabling predictive analytics and smarter decision-making.
• Mentorship & Leadership: Mentored engineering teams, improving code quality and accelerating delivery timelines through best practices and streamlined processes.
• Business Alignment: Partnered with sales and delivery teams to craft technical solutions that directly addressed client needs, contributing to revenue growth.

positions.title: Lead Architect / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led our internal product team to design, build and deploy a white label ecommerce platform. Worked with our product manager and owners to bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation.

Notable Contributions:
•	Developed custom Kubernetes Helm charts to simplify our cluster management and allow quick creation of new environments.
•	Collaborated with DevOps group to build infrastructure pipelines with Terraform and GitHub Actions to allow for quick testing and updates through environments while maintaining quality and compliance checks at each stage.
•	Spearheaded the development and design of Spring Boot backend allowing our engineering team to move quickly while maintaining consistent standards throughout the code base.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provided high-level technical expertise in defining, building, and testing software across multiple platforms (iOS, Android, Web and Backend). 

Notable Contributions:
•	Design and development of a Spring Boot platform SDK by implementing Project Reactor and the WebFlux stack; integrating with Redis, PostgreSQL, and various third-party APIs.
•	Leveraged SalesForce CRM as a backend for a fast paced experimental client project which allowed us to hit the tight deadline while providing a familiar admin and lead generation panel for their sales teams.
•	Converted ARM based head unit to run on x86 processors to enable developers to build applications for the head unit from their computers without the need for an expensive OEM test bench unit.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer 
Worked on multiple projects for Fortune 500 companies with a focus on Android and iOS native mobile development.

Notable Contributions:
•	Designed the architecture for Jimmy John’s native mobile app to ensure consistency and quality code while reducing code duplication and allowing our team to hit the delivery deadline on time.
•	Built a 2nd screen experience for Chevrolet’s Super Bowl commercial enabling customers to interact with the commercials during the game and win prizes along the way.
•	Created the open source code analysis Gradle tool Gnag to integrate with GitHub allowing instant feedback on pull requests freeing up the teams time by not focusing on common code issues during PR reviews.

positions.title: Co - Founder / Managing Member
positions.description:
Co-Founder/Engineer
Coordinated all stages for product development for small start-up, from product design, improvement, deployment, and launch. Outlined targets, specifications, action plans, and led the implementation of initiatives to foster business growth.

Notable Contributions:
•	Oversaw all aspects of project lifecycle and directed employee activities to ensure the timely delivery of milestones in alignment with client requirements; monitored project scope, performance, budget, and costs.
•	Consulted and built the initial Android application for a large mortgage lender.
•	Creation of RanDinger, which allowed users to randomly change ringtones by selecting artists/genres/albums of music that would play after every call.
•	Collaborated with 7Digital to facilitate the provision of free ringtones for users and also upsold the option for song purchases to increase sales.
•	Scheduled and facilitated meetings with a small start-up company to understand the company’s technical needs; collaborated with engineers in the company to design, develop, and launch their mobile applications.

projects.title: Labs Cloud
projects.description: Led the design and development of a Spring Boot framework to allow rapid development of common features for our client projects. Framework components decreased development time by up to 30% while improving security with industry standard patterns.
